minutes.headline: Library trustees approved the January minutes and heard the director's report before a Finance Committee budget presentation.
minutes.summary: The Library Board met remotely, approved the January 21 minutes as amended by roll call, and heard the director's FY21 budget status, programs, building projects and strategic plan update. The board noted the director would present the FY22 request to the Finance Committee at 7:30 that night. The meeting adjourned by roll call vote.

budget_items.what_was_said: Two-thirds through the year; heating and electricity are catching up to run rate and salaries are about as expected given vacancies.
Cleaning is paid from the DPW building maintenance line so it won't affect the library's appropriated funds.
Library received the preliminary budget from the town manager and was to present requests to the Finance Committee that evening.
Sign-up capacity was expanded, costing slightly more per program, funded as the director said was available.
Upgrades postponed to the first week of March, funded by the friends endowment.
An RFP for carpet is being drawn up; phone repairs need estimates, and which budget pays for phone maintenance was unresolved.
The store donated gift certificates as focus group incentives, routed through the Friends.

what_happened.line: The Library Board approved the January 21 minutes as amended, by roll call, with no dissent recorded.
The director reported that FY21 spending was two-thirds through the year, with heating and electricity catching up and salaries near expectations given vacancies.
The director said cleaning is paid from the DPW building maintenance line, so it does not draw on the library's appropriation.
The library received a preliminary FY22 budget from the town manager and was to present its requests to the Finance Committee that evening.
Which budget pays for phone maintenance was left unresolved; the director is to ask the facilities head and IT. Strategic plan focus groups were set for March 3, 4 and 6.

why_it_matters: The library's FY22 request goes to the Finance Committee ahead of the town budget vote, and some library costs, such as cleaning, sit in other departments' lines rather than the library's own.
Phone maintenance has no settled budget home yet, so it could land on the library's line or on a town line.
watch_next: The Finance Committee's handling of the library's FY22 request, presented the evening of this meeting.
The strategic plan focus groups on March 3, 4 and 6, and the answer on which budget covers phone maintenance.
